text:
sam_partnerships: Quick sync  Nimbus wants a flow for Redwood attestation + SKU split (hosted-only, downloadable/redistrib, SI offline). Need legal + infra + marketing alignment.
rachel_legal: Two-track is fine: Hosted-only (no download/redistrib) and Redistributable (separate fee + indemnity). Add 'no endorsement' sentence and require attestation metadata to remain intact.
tom_infra: Implementation: manifest with artifact_sha256 and artifact_sha512, signer_kid, signer_version, provenance_url, license_sku. Sign manifest with KMS-backed ECDSA; output signature.sig and public_key.pem. We'll publish static verifier binaries (linux x86_64 + arm64) for offline SI installs.
emily_pm: Nimbus requests marketplace tile week of May 12, SI co-announce two weeks later. Marketing wants a 'Redwood Attested' badge; want two tile templates.
harry_marketing: I'll create two tile variants and three short badge options: 'Redwood Attested' preferred. Need short explainer copy clarifying attestation != endorsement.
olga_si: For air-gapped SI bundles please include manifest.json, signature.sig, public_key.pem, verifier binary, signer_version timestamp, and allowlist file. Many customers ask for SHA512 so include both checksums.
build_bot: signer-ci: build 3300012300 succeeded (artifact: signer-api:3300012300)
sam_partnerships: Draft SKU mapping: RLW-NIM-HOST-01 (hosted-only, attested); RLW-NIM-DL-02 (hosted + downloadable, redistrib add-on via contract); RLW-NIM-SI-03 (SI offline installer, verifier binary, signer cert).
rachel_legal: Contract blurb: "Artifact attestation confirms origin/integrity but does not modify license rights. Redistribution beyond the purchased SKU requires a separate redistribution license and written approval from Redwood. Parties may not imply Redwood endorsement."
tom_infra: Rotation plan: signer_kid in manifest and a revocation list endpoint; offline bundles include signer_version allowlist file customers can import. Verifier returns exit code 0 on success, non-zero on mismatch.
emily_pm: Action items: Rachel finalize wording by Thu EOD; Tom publish manifest schema + verifier by Fri; Harry prepare badge + tile copy; Sam will send SKU proposal to Nimbus PM and SI contacts.
